_comment: The canonical quickstart snippets, owned by the library that has to make
here against `tests/djangoproject/` — the Django project this repository
actually runs in CI — so a snippet cannot drift from a working
configuration without a test going red.
docs.grantor.id vendors this file and checks its own copy against it,
the same arrangement the API contract already has between the backend
and the frontend: one owner, a synced copy, and a drift check on each
side. Cross-repository freshness is a sync step, not a machine check.
A quickstart that does not run costs the reader their trust in their
first minute, which is the most expensive minute there is.
settings:
GRANTOR_ISSUER = "https://acme.api.grantor.id"
GRANTOR_CLIENT_ID = env("GRANTOR_CLIENT_ID")
GRANTOR_CLIENT_SECRET = env("GRANTOR_CLIENT_SECRET")
